confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates for July 2026, not checked against live listings or current menus. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies a lot by neighborhood and season. Peso-denominated prices are converted at an assumed exchange rate, so USD figures can shift with peso moves. The FX observation came from search-result summaries that cite the RBA exchange-rates table; I did not open the rba.gov.au page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is general knowledge of mid-sized Mexican metropolitan cities with a strong tourism and business market, such as Monterrey and Puebla, adjusted for Guadalajara's pricing relative to Mexico City. Beer and cocktail anchors use the local beer-to-cocktail price relationship where direct knowledge is weaker.
